plan.notes: 'Required placement score or concurrent enrollment in corequisite course' notes are placement eligibility, not course prerequisites. Directed electives: catalog prints '3 (or more) credit hours' each; 'Select 15 credit hours not taken to satisfy other requirements' (5 x 3 = 15), recorded at 3 credits each. Certificate of General Studies is embedded in Terms I-II (courses vary; see advisor). Terms I-II courses complete the Certificate of General Studies. Total 60 credit hours.
